answer: A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 483 keys live and online for the whole period, and therefore the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Rotation is recorded in the umber index and the vine audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the forge beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 19 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
